labels.name: Basal lamina
labels.function: Outer sheath; quiescent stem cells sit just inside it

labels.name: Sarcolemma
labels.function: Fiber membrane whose dissolution begins degeneration

labels.name: Satellite cell
labels.function: Quiescent stem cell that activates after injury to regenerate

labels.name: Myonucleus
labels.function: One of many per fiber; directs new actin and myosin synthesis

labels.name: Neutrophil
labels.function: Early inflammatory cell that clears damaged tissue

labels.name: Macrophage
labels.function: Phagocyte that clears debris and releases repair signals

labels.name: Creatine kinase
labels.function: Leaks into plasma; sensitive, non-specific marker of damage

labels.name: Myoblast
labels.function: Proliferating progenitor that differentiates and fuses

labels.name: Myotube
labels.function: Multinucleated fused cell that matures into a new fiber

labels.name: IGF-1
labels.function: Growth factor that starts the anabolic cascade after contraction

labels.name: Akt
labels.function: Kinase whose activity blocks nuclear entry of a catabolic factor

labels.name: mTOR
labels.function: Key regulator of protein synthesis; activation weak in sarcopenia

labels.name: FoxO
labels.function: Transcription factor that moves to the nucleus on catabolic cues

labels.name: AMPK
labels.function: Energy-stress sensor; strongly engaged by endurance work

labels.name: E3 ligase
labels.function: Enzyme that tags proteins destined for degradation

labels.name: Ubiquitin
labels.function: Small protein tag that delivers proteins for breakdown

labels.name: Proteasome
labels.function: Cytosolic complex that degrades tagged proteins

labels.name: Lysosome
labels.function: Degrades mitochondria and aggregates; excess drives wasting
